decisions.reason: As an adjacent industrial system with likely low carrying cost and still not fully resolved market potential, we would keep this option open unless 2022 sales clearly disappoint.

This coolant-filter product fits the firm's machinery portfolio, and with uncertain but potentially valuable niche demand, the option value of staying in the market still outweighs the cost of maintaining it.

Although somewhat more exposed to later rationalization because it sits near other filtration offerings, it is still worth keeping on the market while the firm learns more about customer adoption and application fit.
